structured_output.what_is_happening: KARDASHEV "Kardashev Research" (6MuH…) is one of at least 10 same-name copies launched within about 3 hours. It appears to be riding a tweet from the beffjezos account. The GMGN project website link points to a different contract (5wW9…), which is earlier and sits at about $1.8M market cap, so this is a copycat. The coin pumped about +175% in its first ~20 minutes, then fell -47% in 5 minutes and -61% over 15 minutes. It is now around $170k market cap with about $40k liquidity. One unlabeled wallet holds 80% of supply, likely a second pool or curve account, but that is unconfirmed. RugCheck flags 99.99% of LP as unlocked. GMGN tags 51 wallets as bundlers.

narrative.description: This is a Beff Jezos / e/acc 'Kardashev' themed meme. It is a real cult-tech narrative, and the canonical token has already reached about $1.8M.
narrative.why_spreading: A tweet from a known e/acc personality spawned many ticker clones. Attention is going to the leader, 5wW9…, not to this copy.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker. It was deployed about 2 hours after the leading contract, and its own metadata links to the leader's contract.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 5wW9… ($1.8M, earliest and likely canonical), 8Rz6… ($423k, $9.9M h1 volume), Gff9… ($212k liquidity), 6SBi…, and several dead copies.

authenticity.evidence: The packet counts 2125 unique buyers against only 95 unique sellers over 30 minutes, which fits bot or airdrop-style buying. GMGN tags 51 bundler wallets. The coin has 10k transactions on a $170k cap, a turnover of 33x. The launch was a Meteora virtual curve, created and migrated in the same second. The token image has 6 duplicates. The tweet from the real influencer account is organic, but it is not about this contract.
